loops.operand_stats: Nested loops performing 256-bit VLI multiplication using MAC operations. Operands are 32-bit arrays. The outer loop trip count is up to 8 (for secp256r1).
Straight-line, heavily repeated pattern of big-integer addition and subtraction on 256-bit data types, primarily executing through calls to uECC_vli_add and uECC_vli_sub.
Performs a wide (256-bit) subtraction followed by an optional conditional addition if a borrow occurred. Operands are arrays of eight 32-bit words.
